about:
Servco Automotive Distribution, based in Honolulu, Hawaii, has been importing and distributing vehicles and parts since 1958. The company serves as the distributor for Toyota, Lexus, and Subaru vehicles, as well as Toyota Industrial Equipment, across the Hawaiian Islands.

The operation spans a Parts Center on Sand Island in Oahu, a Vehicle Processing Center for inspection, preparation, body work, painting, and accessory installation, and Carrier Services that transport vehicles from ports to storage and dealerships. A Quality Division provides technical assistance, regulatory compliance, training, warranty administration, and dealer service support to the network of over 30 dealerships in Hawaii and Australia.

Servco's customers are primarily franchised dealerships for Toyota, Lexus, Subaru, and Chevrolet in Hawaii, along with independent dealers and industrial equipment buyers. The distribution division coordinates product planning, inventory control, port operations, storage, parts distribution, and after-sale service.

The company emphasizes delivering vehicles with the lowest possible mileage to dealer lots and offering the widest selection of genuine factory and aftermarket parts through its Parts Center.
